name: Rechrg
tagline: Fleet-grade charging infrastructure for shared e-mobility operators
positioning: Rechrg is the enterprise charging network that keeps e-scooter and e-bike fleets powered, monitored, and audit-ready across every city you operate in.

hero.h1: Charging infrastructure built for shared mobility fleets
hero.sub: Rechrg unifies depot chargers, swap cabinets, and on-street docks into one network operators can meter, monitor, and reconcile down to the kilowatt-hour.

features.title: Per-kWh metering
features.description: Every session is metered at the connector and reconciled to your utility bill, so finance can attribute energy cost to each vehicle and city.

features.title: Fleet uptime SLAs
features.description: Guaranteed connector availability with automated failover routing that reroutes idle vehicles to the nearest live charge point.

features.title: Depot orchestration
features.description: Schedule overnight charging around off-peak tariffs and stagger loads to keep depot draw under your grid connection cap.

features.title: Utilization analytics
features.description: See dwell time, throughput, and cost-per-charge across every dock, cabinet, and depot in a single operations dashboard.

features.title: Grid compliance reporting
features.description: Export demand-response records and emissions data formatted for municipal permits and enterprise ESG audits.

features.title: Open API and telematics
features.description: Sync charge state directly into your fleet management system with webhooks and a documented REST API.

testimonials.quote: Before Rechrg our depot team reconciled charging costs on spreadsheets across four cities. Now every kilowatt-hour maps to a vehicle and a tariff automatically. It closed our monthly energy audit from nine days to one.
testimonials.name: Marta Vidal

testimonials.quote: We deployed Rechrg swap cabinets across twelve districts in a single quarter. The uptime SLA is the reason our council contract renewed.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: The grid-compliance exports paid for themselves at our first permit review. Rechrg handed the auditors exactly the demand-response records they asked for.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
